desc:
Welcome to Dawg Fights, fast-paced jet dogfights on Roblox! Fight 1v1 up to 5v5 in the sky, where the first team to 5 round wins takes the match.

✈️ Step on a duel pad or press Play to find a match!
🔫 Pick a jet, a gun and a heavy weapon, and switch any time with M!
🚀 Lock on and fire missiles, rail cannons, scatter rockets... and the NUKE!
🌀 Dodge incoming missiles with barrel rolls, loops and split-S turns!
☁️ Hide in the clouds to lose missiles and the enemy's eyes!
🛩️ Unlock new jets, each with its own speed, turning, armour and weapons!
🎨 Collect skins, finish tasks and level up the pass for rewards!
🏆 Run the Daily Gauntlet and keep your win streak alive!

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones and Tablets!

Controls:
💻 PC
Mouse: Aim
LMB: Shoot
F: Fire missile
Shift: Afterburner
W / S: Throttle
Space: Dodge move
E: Flare
M: Change loadout

📱 Mobile
Stick to steer, buttons to fire, ▲ ▼ for throttle

⚠️ Cheaters and exploiters will be banned.
